name: erplora-hub
description: ERPlora hub — monorepo. JS/TS via pnpm workspaces (pnpm-workspace.yaml); Rust crates via Cargo workspace (Cargo.toml).

scripts.verify: node --test scripts/tests/no-dead-packages.test.mjs && pnpm -F @erplora/web verify && pnpm -F @erplora/module-sdk test && pnpm -F @erplora/module-sdk typecheck && pnpm -F @erplora/module-sdk contract:check
